description:
## Problem
Every DuckDB tuned template requests partitioning, which DuckDB always drops (`duckdb.py:1453-1472`). The resulting dropped intents veto verification of the curated product path.

## Change (per gate D-7, option A expected)
- Remove `partitioning` from `examples/tunings/duckdb/*_tuned.yaml` and the packaged mirrors in `benchbox/core/tuning/templates/duckdb/`.
- Mark DuckDB partitioning `rendered_via="none"` in `capability_registry.py`.
- The validator turning this into an error depends on the D-5 amendment and the single-source validator item. Until then, the template change is the whole fix.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Keep `TestPackagedTemplatesParity` green.
- Note the requested-config hash change in release notes.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
